name: gizza-ai/image-crop
summary: Crop a rectangular region from an image fetched by URL.

tool.description: Crop a rectangular region from the image at the given URL. Coordinates are in pixels with (0,0) at the top-left corner. Use when the user asks to keep only part of an image.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL to an image (PNG, JPEG, or WebP).
